VERDICT: APPROVE exact b73692f6a3769ce908b3012dae435751ae61ea1a. Sole parent/base e584ad6; sole assigned docs path; git diff --check clean. Full successor and delta from blocked 7ba9356 reviewed.

The final residual is closed. Section 5.3 now freezes the publication carrier relation: AblationResult or its content-addressed companion binds the checked original bundle identity, typed removed channel and policy derived from the run, and the derived ablated bundle/output identity. M18 changes or removes that evidence while rows, viterbi and logLikelihood remain fixed, so the court detects provenance loss independently of numeric equality. Section 10 now checks every cited candidates, Estimate, GraphHsmm/AblationResult, and external-state source site.

PLAN RECONCILIATION: all chief requirements and all independent findings are present as executable future courts, including finite-before-sort, complete typed outcomes with Credence, derived authority and artifact identities, source-view membership, one effective set, scoped ranks, fusion policy, manual authority, ablation distinction/publication, dedup retention, wire/schema migration, and four construction doors. ERGONOMIC RECONCILIATION: docs-only; no public API is minted, and later vocabulary remains ADR-scoped. SHOULD-HAVE-CHANGED: no unexplained adjacent omission remains. VERIFIED: exact object/parent/path/diff, full document, and each cited current-source seam. INFERRED: implementation names and full-versus-addressed ledger storage remain deliberately open for the ADR/code slice.
